title: Fun
intro: Eight extras for visitors. Switch on the ones you want; each phone sees only those. Photo frame, wheel, animals, paint and the bell flash take turns on the matrix. The bell and guess the song play sound through EZPlayer (0.7 or later) on the show's speakers. Pick the matrix, then Save.

fields.label: Sound of the bell and the songs
options: EZPlayer: the show's speakers, at once
EZPlayer: mixed with the show's music (listeners hear it too)

fields.text: On: a 3-2-1 countdown, a flash, then a frame around the visitor's photo
On

fields.label: Slices, one a line (2 to 12): fx: <effect>, text: <message>, colour: <rrggbb> or again
fields.default:
fx: snowfall
text: Merry Christmas!
colour: ff2a2a
fx: fireworks
again
fx: twinkle
colour: 39d353
text: Ho ho ho!
fields.hint: Effects: snowfall, twinkle, fireworks, bursts, candy, retro, rainbow, plasma, ripple, pacifica, haunted, eyes, fire, lightning, firenoise, blackhole, matrix.

fields.text: On
On: six drawings (tree, star, snowman, present, bauble, bell); the areas fill in turn
On: a bell on this computer's speaker
And a gold flash on the matrix
On: the app switches a snow (or bubble) machine on for a few seconds, then off

fields.label: How the app reaches the machine
options: Web address (smart plug, relay, Shelly, Tasmota)
DMX through EZPlayer (a DMX model in the layout)
DMX by DDP (WLED or a board with a DMX output)
DMX by E1.31 / sACN (a DMX node)
fields.hint: Web address: fill in the two addresses. DMX: fill in the channels and either the model (EZPlayer) or the board's IP address (DDP, Art-Net, E1.31). The README explains each way.

fields.label: Web address: for on (e.g. a smart plug)
DMX: channel=value while it snows (all others 0)
DMX by DDP / Art-Net / E1.31: the board's IP address
Art-Net / E1.31: universe
fields.hint: Art-Net counts universes from 0, E1.31 from 1. DDP has no universe: the DMX channels start at the board's first channel.

fields.label: DMX through EZPlayer: the show's models (tap the snow machine's DMX model)

fields.text: 🫧 Machine with several functions (DMX): the phones pick a mode (bubbles, fog, everything…)

fields.label: Modes, one a line (up to 8): name | channels | at most seconds (optional)
fields.hint: With several functions the Channels box above is not used: each mode has its own. Values from 0 to 10 are off on many machines.

fields.label: Channels sent in every mode (e.g. 4=0 to keep a cleaning mode off)

fields.text: 💡 The machine has lights (DMX): say which channel does what (0 = the machine does not have it)
Allow the strobe (some people are sensitive to flashing lights)
Phones can pick a colour
Phones can pick the rainbow (the machine's own colour changes)
Phones can switch the strobe on (only when allowed above)
Phones can light only the lights, with no bubbles or fog (also while the machine rests or out of hours)

fields.label: Lights during a run when the phone picks no colour
Lights between runs
fields.hint: A colour between runs keeps the machine's DMX (or its EZPlayer model) taken all the time; a dark colour is dim.

fields.text: Falling snow on the matrix while it snows
On: clues on the phones; a right answer lights up the matrix

fields.label: Clues, one a line: question | answer (an answer of digits is a number)
fields.default:
How many reindeer pull Santa's sleigh (without Rudolph)? | 8
What do you put on top of the Christmas tree? | star
What is the snowman's nose made of? | carrot

fields.text: The clues go in order (off: visitors pick any clue)
On: a round for up to 8 phones; a few seconds of a song plays on this computer's speaker

fields.label: Folder with the songs (WAV files, at least 4; the file name is the title)

fields.section: 🎉 When someone wins the treasure hunt or guess the song

fields.text: 🏆 When the treasure is found, and for the winner of guess the song

fields.label: 🔊 Sound
options: Built in: a fanfare for a win, a "wah wah" for a loss

fields.label: My own sound for a win (a WAV file on this computer)

fields.text: 🗣️ Say the words out loud (the computer's own voice, after the sound)

fields.label: Voice language (en, pt, es…; the computer must have that voice)

fields.text: 🔤 Write the words across the lights
🫧 A machine for a few seconds (bubbles, fog, snow, lights…)

fields.label: How the app reaches the machine
options: Web address (smart plug, relay, Shelly, Tasmota)
DMX through EZPlayer (a model in the layout)
DMX by DDP (WLED or a board with a DMX output)
DMX by E1.31 / sACN (a DMX node)

fields.label: DMX by DDP / Art-Net / E1.31: the board's IP address
DMX through EZPlayer: the show's models (tap the machine's model)
The machine rests between two (seconds)
fields.hint: Every other DMX channel is 0, and all go back to 0 at the end. The fun README explains each way of reaching a machine, and DMX channels.
